rules.name: PHP eval
rules.recommendation: PHP eval executes any string. Refactor with proper dispatch tables or json_decode; never eval untrusted input.

rules.name: PHP Shell Command
rules.recommendation: These functions execute a shell command. Use escapeshellarg/escapeshellcmd or a typed library; never concatenate user input.

rules.name: PHP Unserialize With User Input
rules.recommendation: PHP unserialize on user input triggers magic methods and POP chains. Use json_decode or igbinary with a whitelist class option.

rules.name: PHP Dynamic Include From Request
rules.recommendation: Including a request-controlled path leads to RFI/LFI. Resolve against an explicit allowlist of templates.

rules.name: Ruby Marshal.load
rules.recommendation: Marshal.load instantiates any class and runs gadget chains. Use JSON or msgpack for untrusted input.

rules.name: Ruby OpenSSL Verification Disabled
rules.recommendation: VERIFY_NONE disables TLS peer verification. Use VERIFY_PEER and provide a CA bundle via cert_store.
